normalIntro.en: Ferryboat is a plain compound: a boat whose job is to ferry.
normalIntro.cn: ferryboat 是个直白的复合词：一条专职摆渡的船。

normal.en: Ferry is an old verb meaning to carry across, so a ferryboat is a carrying boat.
normal.cn: ferry 是表示「运送过水」的古动词，所以 ferryboat 就是「运送之船」。

normal.en: The plural is simply ferryboats, and the stress stays on the first part.
normal.cn: 复数直接加 s 变成 ferryboats，重音仍在第一部分。

normal.en: By ferryboat is the usual phrase for travelling that way.
normal.cn: by ferryboat 是表示「乘渡船」的常用搭配。

normal.en: A ferryman works the boat, while the ferryboat is the boat itself.
normal.cn: ferryman 是开船的人，ferryboat 则是船本身。

normal.en: Compare ferry, which can mean both the boat and the service.
normal.cn: 对比 ferry：它既可以指船，也可以指渡运服务。

abstract.en: See a flat boat sliding out from a wooden pier.
abstract.cn: 想象一条平底船从木码头滑出。

abstract.en: Watch cars roll single file onto the open deck.
abstract.cn: 想象汽车一辆接一辆开上敞开的甲板。

abstract.en: Hear the engine throb as the boat turns back for the next load.
abstract.cn: 想象发动机低鸣，船掉头去接下一批乘客。

examples.en: We crossed the bay by ferryboat in about twenty minutes.
examples.cn: 我们乘渡船用大约二十分钟穿过了海湾。

examples.en: The car ferryboat carries lorries across the river every hour.
examples.cn: 这艘车辆渡轮每小时把卡车送过河。

examples.en: A small ferryboat was waiting at the wooden pier.
examples.cn: 一条小渡船正在木码头等候。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「费里波特」——想象一个叫费里的人抱着船桨在渡口来回忙活；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: ferry 来自古英语 ferian（运送、摆渡），boat 来自古英语 bat（小船）；两个词复合为 ferryboat，字面就是「用来摆渡的船」，核心义「载人过水」。

sensesIntro.en: Ferryboat starts as the passenger boat, then widens to the drive-on vehicle ferry, and finally names the vessel of a scheduled shuttle.
sensesIntro.cn: ferryboat 先从载客小船讲起，再扩展到能开上车的车辆渡轮，最后指按班次往返的渡船。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flat boat shuttling between two banks.
core.cn: 核心意象：一艘平底船在两岸之间来回摆渡。

branches.en: The passenger boat is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 载客小船是最基本的义项。

branches.en: A drive-on deck makes the vehicle ferry.
branches.cn: 可以开车上船的甲板造就了车辆渡轮。

branches.en: A timetable turns the boat into a scheduled service.
branches.cn: 时刻表让这条船成为班次服务。

branches.en: Both senses name the same hull, only the load differs.
branches.cn: 两个义项指的是同一条船体，只是装载的东西不同。

branches.en: A car ferry often runs to a fixed timetable as well.
branches.cn: 车辆渡轮往往也按固定时刻表往返。

intro.en: Ferryboat is built from two Old English words, ferry and boat, with a small family of ferry words around it.
intro.cn: ferryboat 由 ferry 与 boat 两个古英语词构成，周围有一小族 ferry 词。

latinIntro.en: Ferryboat is Germanic in origin; Latin ferre, to carry, looks similar but is not a cognate.
latinIntro.cn: ferryboat 源于日耳曼语；拉丁语 ferre（携带）只是词形相近，并非同源。

items.example: Farjan is the reconstructed source of ferry.
items.exampleCN: farjan 是 ferry 的重构来源。

items.example: Ferian gave English the verb ferry.
items.exampleCN: ferian 给英语带来了动词 ferry。

items.example: Bat became the modern word boat.
items.exampleCN: bat 演变为现代词 boat。

items.meaning: a small vessel for water travel
items.example: Boat is the second half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: boat 是这个复合词的后半部分。

items.example: Ferry keeps the carrying sense.
items.exampleCN: ferry 保留了「运送」的意思。

items.meaning: a boat or a crossing service
items.example: Ferry as a noun names the boat or the service.
items.exampleCN: 作名词的 ferry 指渡船或渡运服务。

items.meaning: a person who operates a ferry
items.example: The suffix -man marks the person.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -man 标示做这件事的人。

items.meaning: a boat of a stated kind
items.meaningCN: 表示某类船的构词成分
items.example: The combining form appears in ferryboat and houseboat.
items.exampleCN: 这一构词成分见于 ferryboat 与 houseboat。

items.meaning: a boat that ferries people across
items.example: Ferryboat joins the two halves into one noun.
items.exampleCN: ferryboat 把两部分合成一个名词。

definition_zh: 施肥于；使受精；使授粉；使丰富
definition_en: to add nutrients to soil, or to make an egg or flower able to produce new life
core_image: 一只手把黑色的肥料撒进田垄，土里随后冒出新的绿芽
scene: 开春之前，农人把堆肥运到田边，准备给土地补充养分。Before sowing, the farmers fertilise the vegetable beds with compost.
sceneCN: 这里 fertilise 是「给土壤施肥」（第 1 个义项：向土壤补充养分）；句意：播种之前，农人用堆肥给菜畦施肥。

pos.zh: 施肥于；使受精；使授粉；使丰富

derivatives.zh: fertilise 加 -er，指施加到土壤里的肥料
fertilise 加 -ation，指施肥或受精的过程
来自拉丁语 fertilis，指肥沃的、能生育的，是动词的基础形容词
fertile 加 -ity，指肥力或生育力
in- 否定 fertile，指贫瘠的或不育的

senses.title: To add nutrients to soil
senses.definition: to put manure or chemicals into the soil so that crops grow better
senses.definitionCN: 把粪肥或化肥施入土壤，让作物长得更好
senses.example: Farmers fertilise the fields before the spring rains.
senses.exampleCN: 农民在春雨之前给田地施肥。
senses.why: The Latin root fertilis means fruitful, so the verb first means making land fruitful.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 fertilis 意为「能结果的」，所以这个动词首先指让土地变得能结果。

senses.title: To make an egg able to develop
senses.definition: to join a male and a female cell so that a new organism can begin
senses.definitionCN: 使雄性与雌性生殖细胞结合，从而开始孕育新个体
senses.example: Only one sperm can fertilise the egg.
senses.exampleCN: 只有一个精子能使卵子受精。
senses.why: The fruitful image moves from soil to living cells, where fertilising starts new life.
senses.whyCN: 「使能结果」的画面从土壤移到活细胞，受精正是新生命的开始。

senses.title: To carry pollen to a flower
senses.definition: to transfer pollen so that a plant can produce seeds
senses.definitionCN: 把花粉送到花的雌蕊，使植物能够结籽
senses.example: Bees fertilise the apple blossoms as they feed.
senses.exampleCN: 蜜蜂采蜜时给苹果花授粉。
senses.why: In botany the fruitful outcome is seed, so the same verb covers pollination.
senses.whyCN: 在植物学里「结果」就是结籽，因此同一个动词也用来指授粉。

senses.title: To enrich a mind or an idea
senses.definition: to make something richer or more productive in a figurative way
senses.definitionCN: 比喻义：使思想或创意变得更丰富、更有产出
senses.example: Travel can fertilise the imagination.
senses.exampleCN: 旅行能丰富人的想象力。
senses.why: The agricultural image of feeding the soil extends easily to feeding ideas.
senses.whyCN: 给土壤补充养分的农业画面，很自然地延伸到给思想提供养分。

intro.en: Fertilise builds on fertile, from Latin fertilis, fruitful, and carries the Latin verb ending through French.
intro.cn: fertilise 由 fertile 构成，源自拉丁语 fertilis（能结果的），并经由法语承接了拉丁动词词尾。

items.en: Ferre means to bear or to carry.
items.cn: ferre 意为承载、带来。

items.en: Fertilis means fruitful or able to produce.
items.cn: fertilis 意为能结果、能生产的。

items.en: The suffix -ilis means able to be.
items.cn: 后缀 -ilis 表示「能够被……」。

items.en: Fertile passes into French with the same meaning.
items.cn: fertile 以相同含义进入法语。

items.en: Fertilize appears with the sense of making land fruitful.
items.cn: fertilize 出现，意为使土地变得肥沃。

items.en: British spelling prefers -ise, and the sense extends to eggs and flowers.
items.cn: 英式拼写偏好 -ise，词义扩展到卵子与花朵。

note.en: Fertilise sits inside the fertile family and near words about feeding soil and starting plant life.
note.cn: fertilise 属于 fertile 词族，并与表示给土壤供养、让植物繁殖的词相邻。

entries.definition: able to produce crops, young, or ideas
entries.definitionCN: 肥沃的；能生育的；多产的

entries.definition: material added to soil to supply nutrients
the ability to produce crops or young
animal waste used to enrich soil
to carry pollen to a flower
to improve the quality or richness of something

normalIntro.en: Fertilise is the verb built on fertile, and its family covers soil, seeds, and ideas.
normalIntro.cn: fertilise 是由 fertile 构成的动词，它的词族覆盖土壤、种子与思想。

normal.en: Fertile means fruitful, so to fertilise is to make something fruitful.
normal.cn: fertile 意为能结果的，所以 fertilise 就是使某物能结果。

normal.en: British spelling keeps -ise, while American spelling uses -ize.
normal.cn: 英式拼写用 -ise，美式拼写用 -ize。

normal.en: A fertiliser is the material, and fertilisation is the process.
normal.cn: fertiliser 是材料，fertilisation 是过程。

normal.en: Fertilise an egg is the biological sense of the verb.
normal.cn: fertilise an egg 是这个动词在生物学上的义项。

normal.en: Bees fertilise flowers while they collect nectar.
normal.cn: 蜜蜂采蜜时也为花朵授粉。

abstract.en: Picture a hand scattering dark compost along a furrow.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手沿着田垄撒下深色的堆肥。

abstract.en: See two cells meet under a microscope and begin to divide.
abstract.cn: 想象显微镜下两个细胞相遇并开始分裂。

abstract.en: Watch a bee brush yellow pollen onto a blossom.
abstract.cn: 想象一只蜜蜂把黄色花粉刷到花上。

examples.en: The gardeners fertilise the beds with well-rotted manure every autumn.
examples.cn: 园丁每年秋天用腐熟的粪肥给花坛施肥。

examples.en: The eggs are fertilised outside the female body in this species.
examples.cn: 这个物种的卵子在雌性体外受精。

examples.en: Bees fertilise the fruit trees while they gather nectar.
examples.cn: 蜜蜂采蜜时也给果树授粉。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肥土来滋」——给肥沃的土来点滋养，就是施肥；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 fertilis（能结果的、肥沃的）由 ferre（承载、带来）加 -ilis 构成；英语 fertile 加动词后缀 -ise 得 fertilise，核心义「使能结果」。

sensesIntro.en: Fertilise moves from feeding the soil, to joining cells, to carrying pollen, and finally to enriching the mind.
sensesIntro.cn: fertilise 从给土壤供养，走到使细胞结合、使花授粉，最后引申为丰富思想。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand scattering compost into a furrow.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把堆肥撒进田垄。

branches.en: Feeding the soil is the first and most common sense.
branches.cn: 给土壤供养是最早也最常见的义项。

branches.en: Joining cells repeats the fruitful image inside living bodies.
branches.cn: 细胞结合把「结果」的画面搬进了生命体内部。

branches.en: Pollination is fertilising in the plant kingdom.
branches.cn: 授粉是植物界的受精。

branches.en: Enriching ideas borrows the agricultural image.
branches.cn: 丰富思想借用了农业的画面。

branches.en: Both senses feed something so that it produces more.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是给某物供养，使它产出更多。

intro.en: Fertilise belongs to a Latin family: fertile, fertiliser, fertilisation, fertility, and infertile.
intro.cn: fertilise 属于一个拉丁词族：fertile、fertiliser、fertilisation、fertility 与 infertile。

latinIntro.en: Latin ferre, to bear, gives fertilis, fruitful, and the verb form reached English through French.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ferre（承载）构成 fertilis（能结果的），动词形式经法语进入英语。

items.example: Ferre is the root of fertilis.
items.exampleCN: ferre 是 fertilis 的词根。

items.example: Fertilis gives English fertile.
items.exampleCN: fertilis 给出英语 fertile。

items.example: The suffix -ilis forms adjectives from verbs.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ilis 由动词构成形容词。

items.example: Medieval Latin fertilizare is the verb source.
items.exampleCN: 中世纪拉丁语 fertilizare 是动词来源。

items.meaning: able to produce crops or young
items.example: Fertile is the base adjective.
items.exampleCN: fertile 是基础形容词。

items.example: The suffix -ise forms fertilise in British spelling.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ise 在英式拼写中构成 fertilise。

items.example: Fertilise keeps the making-fruitful sense.
items.exampleCN: fertilise 保留「使能结果」的意思。

items.example: The suffix -er marks the material or agent.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 标示材料或施动者。

items.meaning: the act or process of fertilising
items.example: The suffix -ation marks the process.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ation 标示过程。

items.meaning: not able to produce crops or young
items.example: The prefix in- negates fertile.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 in- 否定 fertile。

definition_zh: 热情的；热诚的；炽烈的；虔诚的
definition_en: showing very strong and sincere feeling about something
core_image: 胸口烧着一团旺火，热气一直往外冒
scene: 球迷挤满看台，围巾在冷风里一片片扬起。A fervent crowd packed the stadium long before the match began.
sceneCN: 这里 fervent 是「热情的、热诚的」（第 1 个义项：对某事怀有强烈而真诚的感情）；句意：比赛开始前很久，热情的观众就挤满了球场。

pos.zh: 热情的；热诚的；炽烈的；虔诚的

derivatives.zh: fervent 加 -ly，指热烈地、热切地
同根名词，指热烈的情感，美式拼写作 fervor
fervent 加 -cy，指热烈、热忱的状态，较少使用
同根形容词，指狂热的、炽热的

senses.title: Full of passionate enthusiasm
senses.definition: showing warm, intense and sincere enthusiasm for a person, cause, or activity
senses.definitionCN: 对某人、某项事业或活动表现出热烈而真诚的热情
senses.example: She is a fervent supporter of the village school.
senses.exampleCN: 她是村校热情的支持者。
senses.why: Latin fervere means to boil, so a fervent person is boiling over with feeling.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 fervere 意为沸腾，所以 fervent 的人就是感情沸溢而出。

senses.title: Deeply devoted in faith
senses.definition: expressing intense devotion to a religion or to a deeply held belief
senses.definitionCN: 对宗教或坚定信念表现出炽烈的虔诚
senses.example: He bowed his head in fervent prayer.
senses.exampleCN: 他低下头热切地祈祷。
senses.why: Boiling heat suits religious language, where devotion is pictured as a burning fire.
senses.whyCN: 沸腾的热度适合宗教语境，虔诚常被比作燃烧的火。

senses.title: Archaically hot or glowing
senses.definition: literally hot, burning, or glowing, as in older medical and scientific writing
senses.definitionCN: 字面指热的、燃烧的、灼热的，多见于早期医学与科学文字
senses.example: The fervent air of the furnace dried the clay at once.
senses.exampleCN: 炉中炽热的空气立刻烘干了黏土。
senses.why: The oldest sense is physical heat, and the emotional senses borrowed it later.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是物理上的热，情感义是后来从它借用的。

intro.en: Fervent comes from Latin fervens, the present participle of fervere, to boil, through Old French.
intro.cn: fervent 来自拉丁语 fervere（沸腾）的现在分词 fervens，经古法语进入英语。

items.en: Fervere means to boil or to glow with heat.
items.cn: fervere 意为沸腾或因热而发光。

items.en: Fervens is the present participle, boiling or glowing.
items.cn: fervens 是现在分词，意为沸腾的、灼热的。

items.en: Fervor is the matching noun for heat or boiling.
items.cn: fervor 是与之对应的名词，表示炽热或沸腾。

items.en: Fervent enters Old French with the sense of boiling and ardent.
items.cn: fervent 进入古法语，兼有「沸腾」与「热烈」之义。

items.en: English records fervent first for physical heat.
items.cn: 英语最早用 fervent 指物理上的热。

items.en: Modern use is almost entirely figurative, meaning ardent or devoted.
items.cn: 现代用法几乎全是比喻义，表示热烈或虔诚。

note.en: Fervent belongs to a small Latin heat family and sits beside adjectives of intense feeling.
note.cn: fervent 属于一个表示「热」的拉丁小词族，并与表达强烈情感的形容词相邻。

entries.definition: intense warmth of feeling
very hot or intensely passionate
in a passionate or eager manner
showing passionate feeling
full of strong emotion
showing eager devotion to a cause

normalIntro.en: Fervent keeps the Latin image of boiling, and most of its modern uses are about feeling, not heat.
normalIntro.cn: fervent 保留拉丁语「沸腾」的画面，现代用法大多指情感而非温度。

normal.en: The root fervere means to boil, so fervent feeling is boiling feeling.
normal.cn: 词根 fervere 意为沸腾，所以 fervent 的感情就是沸腾的感情。

normal.en: Fervent supporter and fervent believer are the two commonest patterns.
normal.cn: fervent supporter 与 fervent believer 是最常见的两种搭配。

normal.en: The adverb is fervently, as in fervently hope.
normal.cn: 副词形式是 fervently，如 fervently hope。

normal.en: The noun is fervour, or fervor in American spelling.
normal.cn: 名词是 fervour，美式拼写为 fervor。

normal.en: Fervent and ferment both go back to fervere, but ferment now means to brew or stir up.
normal.cn: fervent 与 ferment 同出 fervere，但 ferment 现在指发酵或煽动。

abstract.en: See a pot of water boiling hard on a stove.
abstract.cn: 想象炉子上的一锅水正猛烈沸腾。

abstract.en: Feel a warm flame burning steadily behind the ribs.
abstract.cn: 想象肋骨后面有一团温暖的火稳定地燃烧。

abstract.en: Watch clasped hands rise in prayer, knuckles tight with feeling.
abstract.cn: 想象紧握的双手在祈祷中抬起，指节因用力而发白。

examples.en: She is a fervent supporter of the local theatre.
examples.cn: 她是当地剧院热情的支持者。

examples.en: His fervent prayer moved everyone in the room.
examples.cn: 他热切的祈祷感动了屋里的每一个人。

examples.en: The crowd gave a fervent cheer when the team scored.
examples.cn: 球队得分时，人群爆发出热烈的欢呼。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「沸温特」——水沸腾了，温度特别高，正合「炽热、热情」的画面；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 fervere（沸腾、发热）的现在分词 fervens，缩为词干 fervent-，经古法语 fervent 进入英语，核心义「像沸水一样滚烫」。

sensesIntro.en: Fervent first names passionate enthusiasm, then deep religious devotion, and still keeps an archaic literal sense of glowing heat.
sensesIntro.cn: fervent 先指热烈的情感，再指深厚的宗教虔诚，同时保留「灼热」的古义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fire burning steadily in the chest.
core.cn: 核心意象：胸口有一团稳定燃烧的火。

branches.en: Everyday enthusiasm is the first sense.
branches.cn: 日常的热情是最先出现的义项。

branches.en: Religious devotion turns the heat into faith.
branches.cn: 宗教虔诚把这份热度变成信仰。

branches.en: The literal sense of heat survives in old writing.
branches.cn: 字面「热」义在旧文字中留存。

branches.en: Both senses share the image of a fire that will not go out.
branches.cn: 两个义项共享一团不熄灭的火的画面。

branches.en: Devotion and physical heat meet in the old image of burning faith.
branches.cn: 虔诚与物理的热在「燃烧的信仰」这一古老画面里相遇。

intro.en: Fervent has a small Latin family of heat words, including fervour, fervid, and the verb fervere.
intro.cn: fervent 有一个表示「热」的拉丁小词族，包括 fervour、fervid 与动词 fervere。

latinIntro.en: Latin fervere, to boil, produces fervens, fervor, and fervidus, all built on the same glowing image.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fervere（沸腾）构成 fervens、fervor 与 fervidus，都建立在同一个「灼热」画面上。

items.example: Fervere is the source of the family.
items.exampleCN: fervere 是这一词族的源头。

items.example: Fervens is the direct source of fervent.
items.exampleCN: fervens 是 fervent 的直接来源。

items.example: The ending -ent marks the participle.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ent 标示分词。

items.example: Fervor is the noun of the same root.
items.exampleCN: fervor 是同根名词。

items.example: Fervidus gives English fervid.
items.exampleCN: fervidus 给出英语 fervid。

items.example: Fervent keeps the participle form.
items.exampleCN: fervent 保留了分词形式。

items.example: The noun drops the participle ending.
items.exampleCN: 名词形式去掉了分词词尾。

items.example: Fervid is the shorter adjective.
items.exampleCN: fervid 是较短的形容词。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms the adverb.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 构成副词。

senses.title: Intense enthusiasm
senses.definition: strong, eager feeling about an activity, cause, or person
senses.definitionCN: 对某项活动、事业或人怀有强烈而急切的热忱
senses.example: The volunteers worked with fervor all morning.
senses.exampleCN: 志愿者们整个上午都干得热火朝天。
senses.why: Latin fervor means boiling heat, and enthusiasm is pictured as something boiling inside.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 fervor 意为沸腾的热度，热情就像心里有东西在沸腾。

senses.title: Devout intensity in religion
senses.definition: intense devotion expressed in religious belief or worship
senses.definitionCN: 在宗教信仰或礼拜中表现出的炽烈虔诚
senses.example: Religious fervor swept through the frontier towns.
senses.exampleCN: 宗教虔诚的热潮席卷了边疆小镇。
senses.why: The heat image suits faith, so fervor often names religious devotion.
senses.whyCN: 「热」的画面很适合信仰，因此 fervor 常指宗教上的虔诚。

senses.title: Passionate force in speech or feeling
senses.definition: the intense force of an emotion, a speech, or a performance
senses.definitionCN: 情感、言辞或表演中炽烈而有力的强度
senses.example: He defended the plan with unexpected fervor.
senses.exampleCN: 他出人意料地激烈地为这个计划辩护。
senses.why: Boiling feeling spills into words, so fervor also measures the heat of speech.
senses.whyCN: 沸腾的情感会溢到言辞里，所以 fervor 也用来衡量话语的热度。

senses.title: Archaic literal heat
senses.definition: literal heat or feverish warmth, as used in older medical texts
senses.definitionCN: 字面意义上的热或发烧般的热度，见于较早的医学文字
senses.example: The fervor of the wound warned the surgeon of infection.
senses.exampleCN: 伤口的高热让外科医生警觉到感染。
senses.why: The physical sense came first and survives only in old or technical writing.
senses.whyCN: 物理上的「热」义出现最早，如今只留在旧文字或技术文字里。

intro.en: Fervor is the Latin noun for boiling heat, from fervere, to boil, and reached English through Old French.
intro.cn: fervor 是拉丁语中表示「沸腾的热」的名词，来自 fervere（沸腾），经古法语进入英语。

items.en: Fervere means to boil or to be hot.
items.cn: fervere 意为沸腾或发烫。

items.en: Fervor means heat, boiling, or ardour.
items.cn: fervor 意为炽热、沸腾或热烈。

items.en: Fervor or fervour carries the noun into French.
items.cn: fervor 或 fervour 把这个名词带入法语。

items.en: Fervour appears with both physical and emotional senses.
items.cn: fervour 出现时兼有物理与情感两种含义。

items.en: American dictionaries drop the u and settle on fervor.
items.cn: 美国词典省去 u，定为 fervor。

items.en: Modern English keeps fervor mainly for intense feeling.
items.cn: 现代英语主要用 fervor 表示强烈的情感。

note.en: Fervor is the noun beside fervent, close to its British twin fervour and to words for strong feeling.
note.cn: fervor 是与 fervent 对应的名词，与英式双胞胎 fervour 以及表示强烈情感的词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Fervor is the noun of the boiling family, and the American spelling has no u.
normalIntro.cn: fervor 是「沸腾」词族的名词，美式拼写不带 u。

normal.en: The Latin noun fervor means boiling heat.
normal.cn: 拉丁名词 fervor 意为沸腾的热度。

normal.en: British writing uses fervour, while American writing uses fervor.
normal.cn: 英式写作作 fervour，美式写作作 fervor。

normal.en: With fervor is a common phrase for doing something passionately.
normal.cn: with fervor 是表示「热情地做某事」的常用短语。

normal.en: Religious fervor and patriotic fervor are fixed collocations.
normal.cn: religious fervor 与 patriotic fervor 是固定搭配。

normal.en: The adjective is fervent, so fervor and fervent share one idea.
normal.cn: 形容词是 fervent，因此 fervor 与 fervent 共享同一个意念。

abstract.en: Hear a kettle whistle as the water boils hard.
abstract.cn: 想象水猛烈沸腾时壶嘴发出的鸣响。

abstract.en: See a torch flame lean and crackle in the wind.
abstract.cn: 想象火把的火焰在风里倾斜、噼啪作响。

abstract.en: Watch a crowd rise to its feet, cheering as one.
abstract.cn: 想象人群一齐站起，齐声欢呼。

examples.en: The crowd cheered with fervor as the team scored.
examples.cn: 球队得分时，人群热情地欢呼。

examples.en: Religious fervor swept through the small town.
examples.cn: 宗教虔诚的热潮席卷了这座小镇。

examples.en: She spoke with such fervor that the whole room listened.
examples.cn: 她讲得如此热情，整个房间的人都在听。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「沸窝」——心里的热情像沸水在窝里翻滚；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 fervor（沸腾、炽热）由 fervere（沸腾）加名词词尾 -or 构成，经古法语进入英语；美式拼写省去 u，核心义「心里烧开的热度」。

sensesIntro.en: Fervor runs from everyday enthusiasm, through religious devotion, to the heat of speech, and keeps an archaic sense of literal heat.
sensesIntro.cn: fervor 从日常热情，走到宗教虔诚，再到言辞的炽烈，并保留字面「热」的古义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fire burning behind the ribs and pushing a person forward.
core.cn: 核心意象：肋骨后面有一团火，推着人向前。

branches.en: Enthusiasm for an activity is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 对活动的热情是日常义项。

branches.en: Religious devotion is the faith sense.
branches.cn: 宗教虔诚是信仰义项。

branches.en: The heat of speech is the expressive sense.
branches.cn: 言辞的炽烈是表达义项。

branches.en: Literal heat survives as an archaic sense.
branches.cn: 字面的热作为古义留存。

branches.en: All three living senses describe feeling that will not cool.
branches.cn: 三个现存义项都描述不会冷却的情感。

intro.en: Fervor belongs to the Latin heat family: fervere, fervens, fervent, and fervid.
intro.cn: fervor 属于拉丁语「热」词族：fervere、fervens、fervent 与 fervid。

latinIntro.en: Latin fervere, to boil, gives the noun fervor and the adjective fervidus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fervere（沸腾）构成名词 fervor 与形容词 fervidus。

items.example: Fervere is the source of the noun.
items.exampleCN: fervere 是这个名词的源头。

items.example: The suffix -or turns a verb into a noun.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -or 把动词变成名词。

items.example: The Latin noun already carries both heat and feeling.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词已经兼有热度与情感。

items.example: Fervens is the participle beside the noun.
items.exampleCN: fervens 是与该名词相伴的分词。

items.example: Fervent is the adjective of fervor.
items.exampleCN: fervent 是 fervor 的形容词。

items.example: Fervor keeps the noun sense in American spelling.
items.exampleCN: fervor 在美式拼写中保留了名词含义。

items.example: Fervour keeps the u of the French form.
items.exampleCN: fervour 保留了法语形式的 u。

items.example: Fervid is the shorter adjective of the family.
items.exampleCN: fervid 是这一词族中较短的形容词。

items.example: The ending -our marks the British spelling.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -our 标示英式拼写。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms the adverb.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 构成副词。
